en: Colorized historic postcard view of a European city riverfront. A bridge crosses a river with pedestrians on it, and along the opposite bank stand multi‑story buildings with red roofs and shop signs. A tall church tower with a green onion-shaped dome rises on the right. In the background a steep, wooded hill topped with fortifications and a prominent clock tower overlooks the city. The printed title at the top reads in German about Graz, the Schlossberg, two bridges, and the Franciscan church.
